title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin is pricing the absence of rate hikes through supply mechanics alone as the Fed's options collapse to zero. Reduced issuance from the 2024 halving is hitting an already thin float, while long-term holder supply keeps climbing and coins exit liquid circulation.

Self-custody has shifted from optional to non-negotiable, with new wallet standards rising across the board. Bitcoin dominance holds at 61.5 percent amid Fear and Greed at 27. Hashrate sits at 987 EH/s, confirming sustained network
